h1: Heart of Harmony Floor Plans: Smart 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK & 4 BHK Home Layouts Designed for Real Life

blocks.text: At Heart of Harmony, size alone does not define quality. What matters more is how space is planned and how it supports everyday living. The focus is to make every square foot more usable, efficient, and intuitive — the result is a set of homes where layout decisions are driven by real-life needs, privacy, ventilation, and adaptability.

Heart of Harmony offers 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK sky residences at Kudlu Gate, Hosur Road, Bengaluru. Every floor plan in the project is designed around how families actually live — not how a home looks on a brochure. With only 6 residences per floor and zero common walls, each apartment has three-sided openings delivering 270° panoramic views. CKPC Heart of Harmony is developed by CKPC Properties Pvt. Ltd., RERA: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 .
Why Floor Plan Design Matters More Than Square Footage

The floor plans at Heart of Harmony are designed in a way that minimises dead space, applies clear zoning, and provides well-proportioned rooms that allow for flexible use. Each home is designed to ensure that ventilation feels natural, furniture placement is practical, and spaces connect seamlessly without feeling constrained.

One of the defining aspects of the layouts is the way spaces are clearly zoned yet visually connected. Living and dining areas are positioned to function as shared spaces, while bedrooms are placed to ensure privacy and quietness. A key feature is the presence of zero common walls, which significantly reduces sound transfer and enhances personal space within each home.
Heart of Harmony 3 BHK Floor Plan
The 3 BHK floor plans at Heart of Harmony are available in two configurations — 1,786 sq ft and 1,981 sq ft carpet area. Both configurations deliver:

items: Three full bedrooms with attached bathrooms — master bedroom with walk-in wardrobe provision
Open-plan living and dining flowing onto a private balcony
Modular kitchen with utility balcony access
Zero common walls — three-sided openings for 270° panoramic views

blocks.text: The 3 BHK Classic and Premium variants are designed for families of three to four who want three fully independent bedrooms, a generous living area, and the low-density privacy of a 6-homes-per-floor building. Contact the sales team at +91 76499 99586 for current pricing and availability.
Heart of Harmony 3.5 BHK Floor Plan

The 3.5 BHK floor plan is available in 2,132 sq ft carpet area and is the most sought-after configuration at Heart of Harmony. The defining feature is a dedicated study or home office room — separate from the three bedrooms — making this the ideal layout for professionals who work from home two or three days a week.

items: Three full bedrooms with attached bathrooms
Dedicated study room — separate, quiet, purpose-built workspace
Larger living-dining area compared to the 3 BHK configurations
Dual balcony access in select units
Zero common walls — 270° views from three sides

blocks.text: The 3.5 BHK is the configuration that Heart of Harmony currently ranks Position 1 for in the ‘luxury 3.5 BHK near Silk Board’ and Position 2 for ‘3.5 BHK apartments in Kudlu Gate’ searches — reflecting genuine demand for this layout at this address.
Heart of Harmony 4 BHK Floor Plan

The 4 BHK Grande floor plan at Heart of Harmony is available in 2,550 sq ft carpet area — the most spacious configuration in the project. It is designed for large families, multi-generational households, or buyers who want the highest specification in the building.

items: Four full bedrooms each with an attached bathroom
Grand entrance foyer flowing into formal living and dining zones
Full-size modular kitchen with utility and service access
Two or more private balconies depending on unit position
Zero common walls — 270° panoramic openings from three sides

blocks.text: The 4 BHK Grande is positioned in the ultra-luxury segment. For current pricing and floor-wise availability, contact the sales team at +91 76499 99586 .
Light, Ventilation, and Expansive Views

Heart of Harmony floor plans are designed to maximise light, air, and outward connection. With 270° panoramic views, homes open up to their surroundings, creating a strong sense of openness. Well-placed balconies ensure that natural light enters the home, while ventilation is maintained across all spaces. This reduces dependence on artificial lighting and cooling, while also improving everyday comfort.

The planning extends beyond individual homes into shared architectural features. Open-to-sky garden decks placed every three floors act as intermediate spaces that bring nature into the building. These decks function as extensions of living spaces, offering residents accessible outdoor zones within the building itself — creating a more balanced living environment where private homes are complemented by shared, breathable spaces. See how the private garden terraces work
From Smart Layouts to the Full Master Plan

Smart home layouts are one component of the Heart of Harmony master plan — a 24-floor, single-tower development on Hosur Main Road, Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru 560068. For the complete picture of how site layout, tower design, vehicle-free podium, amenity distribution, and floor plan configurations all work together, read the Heart of Harmony master plan .

At Heart of Harmony, smart layouts are planned with clarity and purpose. Every element — from zoning and privacy to light and shared spaces — is designed to support everyday living. The result is a home that does not just look well-planned, but feels easy to live in, where design quietly supports everyday life without drawing attention to itself.
To request the full floor plan brochure with detailed drawings and carpet area specifications, request the Heart of Harmony brochure or contact the sales team .
Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: What makes Heart of Harmony floor plans different from standard apartments?
items.a: Heart of Harmony floor plans are designed with zero dead space, three-sided openings for 270° views, open-plan living-to-kitchen flow, and clear bedroom zoning for privacy. Only 6 homes per floor and zero common walls mean every resident gets privacy and natural light that standard high-rises cannot offer.

items.q: Q: What BHK types are available at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Heart of Harmony offers 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK sky residences at Kudlu Gate, Hosur Road, Bengaluru. Carpet areas: 3 BHK at 1,786 sq ft and 1,981 sq ft. 3.5 BHK at 2,132 sq ft with dedicated study room. 4 BHK Grande at 2,550 sq ft. All configurations have zero common walls and three-sided 270° panoramic views.

items.q: Do Heart of Harmony apartments have natural ventilation?
items.a: Yes. Heart of Harmony homes are designed with three-sided openings and well-placed balconies to ensure cross-ventilation and natural light throughout. Open-plan layouts minimise the need for artificial lighting and cooling, while garden terraces every three floors add an additional layer of natural airflow and greenery.

items.q: What is the size of 3 BHK apartments at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Heart of Harmony 3 BHK apartments are available in two sizes: 1,786 sq ft and 1,981 sq ft carpet area. For current pricing and detailed floor plan specifications, contact +91 76499 99586 or sales@ckpcproperties.com .

items.q: Are there private garden spaces in Heart of Harmony homes?
items.a: Yes. Open-to-sky garden decks are placed every three floors at Heart of Harmony, bringing natural light, fresh air, and a private outdoor space to residents across all floors. These function as extensions of the living space — a key PX design feature at Heart of Harmony.

items.q: How many homes are on each floor at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Only 6 residences per floor — with zero common walls between apartments. This low-density design gives every home three open sides for views, ventilation, and privacy. With 137 total homes across 24 floors, Heart of Harmony is one of Bengaluru’s most boutique luxury high-rises.

items.q: What is open-plan layout design in apartments?
items.a: Open-plan layout refers to a floor plan where the living room, dining area, and kitchen flow together without walls dividing them, creating a sense of spaciousness and better light distribution. Heart of Harmony uses this design across all configurations — 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK and 4 BHK — to maximise usable space and create homes that feel larger than their carpet area suggests.

items.q: What does 270° panoramic views mean in an apartment?
items.a: 270° panoramic views means the home opens on three sides — front, one side, and back — giving residents sweeping views of the surrounding cityscape and landscape from multiple angles. Heart of Harmony’s 24-storey height and zero-common-wall design amplify this effect significantly, particularly on upper floors above the surrounding urban density.

items.q: Who is the developer of Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Heart of Harmony is developed by CKPC Properties Pvt. Ltd., a Bengaluru-based developer with over 8 million sq ft of Grade A+ commercial spaces delivered for Fortune 100 companies including TCS, Siemens, Bosch and Merck. Heart of Harmony is CKPC’s flagship luxury residential project. RERA: PRM/KA/RERA/1251/310/PR/310326/008560 .

items.a: You can view floor plan overviews on the Heart of Harmony homes page or request the full brochure with detailed floor plan drawings . For a personal walkthrough with the sales team, contact +91 76499 99586 or visit the experience centre on Hosur Main Road, Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru 560068.
